title: Orthoimage
limitations: The colour COG has about 7.74% greyscale strips in the AOI window (nearest-neighbour sample). JPEG tiles have no alpha: pixels outside the source mask and outside the area of interest are written in the map background colour (04 `void`), not transparent, and the manifest has no coverage polygon. Black pixels the source marks valid are shown as they are; the product page does not say what black means.
